captures.description: THE ARGUMENT ADDRESS FOR REVELATION FIRST, 2026-11-04, WITH THREE FURTHER TURNS: the method (ancestry, four categories), the Gallio problem, the seven-church architecture, the Muratorian Fragment, the work–toil–endurance triad, the crown of life (census, the life-system, the performed and the reported promise, the surrounding ideas), the 4 Maccabees audit, the research programme, the defeat conditions, an assessment ranking corpus, generative and absolute priority, and bibliographic details. Then three turns after the operator's objections (not in the paste): the Gallio inscription conceded to date Gallio only; the error called a failure of reasoning; 'Fair enough. I owe you better scholarship, not more apologies.'

atoms.evidence: Revelation First: Literary Genealogy and the Missing Ancestors of the Epistles
It does not prove that Revelation came first.
It attempts to turn a provocative historical thesis into an experimentally and philologically testable research programme.
The article concludes by giving separate defeat conditions for its three claims.
Stated provenance: Journal of Forensic Semiotics.
